description.from: Purpose: make the score processor deployable by external infrastructure owners without embedding downstream account, pipeline, or environment details in Plexus. Definition of Done: Plexus exposes a public-safe artifact and construct contract, supports immutable image publishing, and documents the build/runtime inputs needed by downstream deployment pipelines.
description.to: Purpose: make the score processor deployable by external infrastructure owners without embedding downstream account, pipeline, or environment details in Plexus. Definition of Done: Plexus packages a public-safe isolated score-processor Dockerfile and handler as a stable package resource, exposes reusable infrastructure constructs, and documents the immutable source-revision inputs needed by downstream release pipelines. Downstream integrations build, validate, scan, publish, and deploy their own image digest; Plexus does not operate a separate mutable artifact pipeline for them.
